022public class LuddicMajority extends BaseMarketConditionPlugin implements MarketImmigrationModifier {
023
024        public static float STABILITY = 1f;
025        public static float IMMIGRATION_BASE = 5f;
026        
027        public static float PRODUCTION_BASE_RURAL = 1f;
028        public static Map<String, Integer> PRODUCTION_OVERRIDES = new LinkedHashMap<String, Integer>();
029        // makes explaining the effect more complicated; don't do it
030        static {
031                //PRODUCTION_OVERRIDES.put(Industries.FARMING, 2);
032        }
033        
034        public static int BONUS_MULT_DEFEATED_EXPEDITION = 2;
035
036        
037        @Deprecated
038        public static String [] luddicFactions = new String [] {
039                "knights_of_ludd",
040                "luddic_church",
041                "luddic_path",
042        };
043        
044        
045        public void apply(String id) {
046                if (!matchesBonusConditions(market)) {
047                        unapply(id);
048                        return;
049                }
050                
051                market.addTransientImmigrationModifier(this);
052                
053                int stability = (int) Math.round(STABILITY * getEffectMult());
054                if (stability != 0) {
055                        market.getStability().modifyFlat(id, stability, "Luddic majority");
056                }
057                
058                float mult = getEffectMult();
059                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
060                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_RURAL) || PRODUCTION_OVERRIDES.containsKey(ind.getId())) {
061                                int production = (int) Math.round(PRODUCTION_BASE_RURAL * mult);
062                                if (PRODUCTION_OVERRIDES.containsKey(ind.getId())) {
063                                        production = (int) Math.round(PRODUCTION_OVERRIDES.get(ind.getId()) * mult);
064                                }
065                                if (production != 0) {
066                                        ind.getSupplyBonusFromOther().modifyFlat(id, production, "Luddic majority");
067                                }
068                        }
069                }
070        }
071
072        public void unapply(String id) {
073                market.removeTransientImmigrationModifier(this);
074                
075                market.getStability().unmodify(id);
076                
077                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
078                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_RURAL) || PRODUCTION_OVERRIDES.containsKey(ind.getId())) {
079                                ind.getSupplyBonusFromOther().unmodifyFlat(id);
080                        }
081                }
082        }
083        
084        public void modifyIncoming(MarketAPI market, PopulationComposition incoming) {
085                float bonus = getImmigrationBonus(true);
086                if (bonus > 0) {
087                        incoming.add(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH, bonus);
088                        incoming.getWeight().modifyFlat(getModId(), bonus, "Luddic immigration (Luddic majority)");
089                }
090        }
091        
092        public float getImmigrationBonus(boolean withEffectMult) {
093                float bonus = IMMIGRATION_BASE * market.getSize();
094                if (withEffectMult) bonus *= getEffectMult();
095                return bonus;
096        }
097        
098        public float getEffectMult() {
099                if (market.isPlayerOwned() && 
100                                LuddicChurchHostileActivityFactor.isDefeatedExpedition()) {
101                        return BONUS_MULT_DEFEATED_EXPEDITION;
102                }
103                return 1f;
104                
105        }
106        
107        protected void createTooltipAfterDescription(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded) {
108                super.createTooltipAfterDescription(tooltip, expanded);
109                
110                String name = market.getName();
111                float opad = 10f;
112                
113                tooltip.addPara("A majority of the population of " + name + " are Luddic faithful. "
114                                + "This may result in a substantial boost "
115                                + "to stability and productivity.", opad);
116                
117                tooltip.addPara("For colonies outside the core, it may also result in increased population growth, "
118                                + "from Luddic immigrants seeking to escape the sometimes oppressive influence of the Luddic Church.", opad);
119
120                tooltip.addPara("%s stability", 
121                                opad, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
122                                "+" + (int)STABILITY);
123                
124                tooltip.addPara("%s production for Farming, Light Industry, and similar", 
125                                opad, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
126                                "+" + (int)PRODUCTION_BASE_RURAL);
127
128                if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
129                        tooltip.addPara("%s population growth",
130                                        opad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
131                                        "+" + (int) getImmigrationBonus(false));
132                }
133
134                if (!Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
135                        addConditions(tooltip, market, opad);
136                }
137        }
138        
139        public static void addConditions(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, MarketAPI market, float opad) {
140                boolean madeDeal = LuddicChurchHostileActivityFactor.isMadeDeal() && market.isPlayerOwned();
141                boolean freePort = market.isFreePort();
142                freePort = false;
143                boolean habitable = market.hasCondition(Conditions.HABITABLE);
144                
145                boolean hasRural = false;
146                boolean hasIndustrial = false;
147                boolean hasMilitary = false;
148                String heavy = null;
149                String military = null;
150                String rural = null;
151                
152                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
153                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_INDUSTRIAL)) {
154                                if (heavy == null) heavy = ind.getCurrentName();
155                                hasIndustrial = true;
156                        }
157                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_MILITARY) || ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_COMMAND)) {
158                                if (military == null) military = ind.getCurrentName();
159                                hasMilitary = true;
160                        }
161                        
162                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_RURAL)) {
163                                if (rural == null) rural = ind.getCurrentName();
164                                hasRural = true;
165                        }
166                }
167                
168                if (market.getConstructionQueue() != null) {
169                        for (ConstructionQueueItem item : market.getConstructionQueue().getItems()) {
170                                IndustrySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getIndustrySpec(item.id);
171                                if (spec != null) {
172                                        if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_INDUSTRIAL)) {
173                                                if (heavy == null) heavy = spec.getName();
174                                                hasIndustrial = true;
175                                        }
176                                        if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_MILITARY) || spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_COMMAND)) {
177                                                if (military == null) military = spec.getName();
178                                                hasMilitary = true;
179                                        }
180                                        
181                                        if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_RURAL)) {
182                                                if (rural == null) rural = spec.getName();
183                                                hasRural = true;
184                                        }
185                                }
186                                break;
187                        }
188                }
189                
190                boolean matches = matchesBonusConditions(market);
191                
192                if (!matches) {
193                        if (market.isPlayerOwned()) {
194                                tooltip.addPara("The following factors result in these bonuses being negated, and, "
195                                                + "unless addressed, will result in the \"Luddic Majority\" condition "
196                                                + "being removed if the colony increases in size:", opad,
197                                                Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), "negated", "removed");
198                        } else {
199                                tooltip.addPara("The following factors result in these bonuses being negated:", opad,
200                                                Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), "negated", "removed");
201                        }
202                        //opad = 5f;
203                        tooltip.setBulletedListMode("    - ");
204                        if (market.getAdmin() != null && market.getAdmin().getId().equals(People.DARDAN_KATO)) {
205                                tooltip.addPara("Dardan Kato's \"policies\"", opad);
206                                opad = 0f;
207                        } else if (market.getAdmin() != null && market.getAdmin().hasTag(Tags.ANTI_LUDDIC_ADMIN)) {
208                                tooltip.addPara("Administration policies", opad);
209                                opad = 0f;
210                        }
211                        
212                        if (madeDeal) {
213                                tooltip.addPara("Deal made with Luddic Church to curtail immigration", opad);
214                                opad = 0f;
215                        }
216                        if (freePort) {
217                                tooltip.addPara("The colony is a free port", opad);
218                                opad = 0f;
219                        }
220                        if (!habitable) {
221                                tooltip.addPara("The colony is not habitable", opad);
222                                opad = 0f;
223                        }
224                        if (!hasRural) {
225                                tooltip.addPara("The colony has no suitable employment for the faithful, such as farming or light industry", opad);
226                                opad = 0f;
227                        }
228                        if (hasIndustrial) {
229                                tooltip.addPara("The colony has heavy industrial facilities (" + heavy + ")", opad);
230                                opad = 0f;
231                        }
232                        if (hasMilitary) {
233                                tooltip.addPara("The colony has military facilities (" + military + ")", opad);
234                                opad = 0f;
235                        }
236                        tooltip.setBulletedListMode(null);
237                } else {
238                        if (market.isPlayerOwned() && LuddicChurchHostileActivityFactor.isDefeatedExpedition()) {
239                                tooltip.addPara("The bonus is doubled due to the faithful " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + 
240                                                        market.getName() + " feeling securely out from under the direct "
241                                                + "influence of the Luddic Church.", opad, Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor(), "doubled");
242                        }
243                }
244                
245                tooltip.setBulletedListMode("    - ");
246                tooltip.setBulletedListMode(null);
247        }
248        
249
250        public static boolean matchesBonusConditions(MarketAPI market) {
251                if (market.isPlayerOwned() && LuddicChurchHostileActivityFactor.isMadeDeal()) return false;
252                
253                // feels a bit too restrictive
254                //if (market.isFreePort()) return false;
255                
256                if (!market.hasCondition(Conditions.HABITABLE)) return false;
257                
258                if (market.getAdmin() != null && market.getAdmin().getId().equals(People.DARDAN_KATO)) {
259                        // he's that dumb about it
260                        return false;
261                }
262                
263                if (market.getAdmin() != null && market.getAdmin().hasTag(Tags.ANTI_LUDDIC_ADMIN)) {
264                        return false;
265                }
266                
267                boolean hasRural = false;
268                for (Industry ind : market.getIndustries()) {
269                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_INDUSTRIAL)) return false;
270                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_MILITARY)) return false;
271                        if (ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_COMMAND)) return false;
272                        
273                        hasRural |= ind.getSpec().hasTag(Industries.TAG_RURAL);
274                }
275                
276                if (market.getConstructionQueue() != null) {
277                        for (ConstructionQueueItem item : market.getConstructionQueue().getItems()) {
278                                IndustrySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getIndustrySpec(item.id);
279                                if (spec != null) {
280                                        if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_INDUSTRIAL)) return false;
281                                        if (spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_MILITARY) || spec.hasTag(Industries.TAG_COMMAND)) return false;
282                                }
283                                break;
284                        }
285                }
286                
287                return hasRural;
288        }
289
290        public String getIconName() {
291                if (!matchesBonusConditions(market)) {// && market.isPlayerOwned()) {
292                        return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("events", "luddic_majority_unhappy");
293                }
294                return super.getIconName();
295        }
296}
